name: pulsar-ide-julia
author: Morgan Rodgers
description: Julia language support for Pulsar via the JETLS language server

server.title: Language server (JETLS)
server.description: Path, Julia, threads, environment, connection, flags and initialization options take effect when the server restarts; the package offers a restart when you change them.

jetlsPath.title: Path to jetls
jetlsPath.description: `jetls` uses `<julia depot>/bin/jetls` when it exists, else the PATH. Or give an absolute path.

juliaPath.title: Julia executable
juliaPath.description: Run JETLS with this Julia (1.12 or newer) instead of the one that installed it.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: `--threads` for the server: `auto`, a number, or `4,2` (default,interactive). Empty: Julia's default.

defaultEnvironment.title: Environment for scripts
defaultEnvironment.description: `--project` for files with no `Project.toml` above them: a path, `~/path` or `@name`.

autoInstantiate.title: Instantiate environments
autoInstantiate.description: When a file's environment needs instantiating (this may download packages and change `Manifest.toml`).

debounce.title: Analysis delay (seconds)
debounce.description: Wait this long after a save before analysing again.

formatter.title: Formatter
formatter.description: For a custom formatter, use the extra settings below.

settingsJson.title: Extra settings (JSON)
settingsJson.description: Merged over the settings above, in the shape of `.JETLSConfig.toml`, e.g. `{"diagnostic": {"all_files": false}}`. A project's `.JETLSConfig.toml` takes precedence.

initializationOptionsJson.title: Initialization options (JSON)
initializationOptionsJson.description: Sent at startup, e.g. `{"reuse_native_inference": true}`. JETLS ignores the whole object if a key is unknown.

channel.title: Connection
channel.description: `pipe` keeps output printed by loaded code away from the protocol; with `stdio` a package banner can break the connection.

juliaFlags.title: Extra Julia flags
juliaFlags.description: Comma-separated flags for the server's Julia, e.g. `--heap-size-hint=4G`.

outline.title: Outline and Go to Symbol
outline.description: How the outline view and the Go to Symbol list (symbols-view) label Julia code.

signatures.title: Signatures
signatures.description: Label functions, types and fields with their signature instead of only their name. In the Go to Symbol list the argument list is shown beside the name, so the methods of a function can be told apart.

locals.title: Arguments and locals
locals.description: Also list each function's arguments, local variables and loop blocks.

repl.title: REPL
repl.description: The Julia REPL in Pulsar's terminal, and the workspace pane that lists its variables.

juliaPath.title: Julia executable
juliaPath.description: Empty: `julia` from the terminal's PATH (so juliaup channels work).

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Empty: the active file's project. Or a folder, `@.`, `@v1.12` or `@name`.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: `--threads`: a number, `auto`, or `auto,1` (default, interactive). Empty: Julia's default (from Julia 1.12, one interactive thread, which lets the workspace pane and Interrupt REPL answer while code runs).

flags.title: Extra arguments
flags.description: Added to the command as written, e.g. `-e 'using Revise'`.

workspace.title: Connect the workspace helper
workspace.description: Start the REPL with a small helper that runs sent code in the right module and lists the REPL's variables in the Workspace pane (the pane needs the `pulsar-ide-debugger` package). Needs Julia 1.9 or newer.

moduleAware.title: Run sent code in its module
moduleAware.description: Evaluate sent code in the module it belongs to, with the file's name and line numbers. Off: type it into the terminal instead. Needs the helper.

inlineResults.title: Inline results
inlineResults.description: Show the result of sent code under it in the editor: the value (click it to see all of it), plots and images, errors with their line, and how long it took. The terminal shows the output as before. Needs the helper and **Run sent code in its module**.

cellSeparators.title: Cell separators
cellSeparators.description: Draw a line above each cell marker (`##`, `#---`, `# %%`) in Julia files.

workspaceModule.title: Workspace module
workspaceModule.description: The module the workspace pane lists, e.g. `Main.MyPackage`, or `@follow` for the one at the cursor. Set from the pane's menu.

sendVia.title: Typing code into the terminal
sendVia.description: Used when code is typed rather than handed to the helper.

enum.description: Terminal service (may ask you to approve)

bracketedPaste.title: Bracketed paste
bracketedPaste.description: Type multi-line code as a single paste. Try this if typed blocks misbehave.

tests.title: Tests
tests.description: Running tests in the REPL (Run Testset in REPL, Run Test File in REPL). Before the tests, Main gets `using Test` and what is chosen here, as `test/runtests.jl` would provide.

environment.title: Use the test environment
environment.description: When the tests have an environment of their own (such as the package's `test/Project.toml`), add it to `LOAD_PATH` so that test-only packages can be loaded. The environment must be instantiated.

loadPackage.title: Load the package being tested
loadPackage.description: Run `using` for the package the test file belongs to, as `test/runtests.jl` usually does.

setup.title: Setup code
setup.description: More Julia code to run in Main first, e.g. `using Aqua; Random.seed!(42)`.

debugger.title: Debugger
debugger.description: Debugging with DebugAdapter.jl, which must be installed in the default environment (`@v1.x`). Breakpoints, stepping and the Workspace pane come from the `pulsar-ide-debugger` package, which must be installed too.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Empty: the project of the file being debugged. Or a folder, `@v1.12` or `@name`.

programArguments.title: Program arguments
programArguments.description: `ARGS` for the debugged script, split like a shell would, e.g. `--n 3 "a b"`.

stopOnEntry.title: Stop on entry
stopOnEntry.description: Pause at the first line, even without breakpoints.

exceptionFilters.title: Break on exceptions
exceptionFilters.description: `error`: uncaught exceptions. `throw`: every exception thrown. Empty: never.

compiledMode.title: Compiled mode
compiledMode.description: Run code you are not stepping through compiled: much faster, but you cannot break inside it.

compiledModules.title: Compiled modules
compiledModules.description: Modules or functions always run compiled, e.g. `Base`, `LinearAlgebra`.

launchArgumentsJson.title: Extra launch arguments (JSON)
launchArgumentsJson.description: Merged into the `launch` request, e.g. `{"cwd": "/tmp"}`; a field set to `null` is removed.
